thought.text: **Keduanya bekerja.** Sekarang saya cek kuota dan rate limit — ini yang menentukan berapa banyak bisa dipakai.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && export CEREBRAS_API_KEY="csk-5hwek3y8kf2cxkdcprxep2m2w5tkwhdp5ywkrr85m8hfc6yk"; echo "=== headers limit ==="; curl -s -D- -o /dev/null --max-time 60 -X POST "https://api.cerebras.ai/v1/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CEREBRAS_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-oss-120b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}],"max_completion_tokens":16}' | grep -iE "ratelimit|x-|retry" | head -20; echo "=== rate limit per menit (burst 25) ==="; ok=0; rl=0; for i in $(seq 1 25); do c=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 30 -X POST "https://api.cerebras.ai/v1/chat/completions" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CEREBRAS_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-oss-120b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"x"}],"max_completion_tokens":8}'); [ "$c" = "200" ] && ok=$((ok+1)) || rl=$((rl+1)); done; echo "200=$ok gagal=$rl"
